electricity_tariff_ore_check.name: electricity_tariff_ore_check
electricity_tariff_ore_check.value: "electricity_tariff"."retail_markup_ore" BETWEEN -1000 AND 1000 AND "electricity_tariff"."grid_transfer_ore" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 AND "electricity_tariff"."energy_tax_ore" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000

ev_charge_energy_mix_kwh_nonneg_check.name: ev_charge_energy_mix_kwh_nonneg_check
ev_charge_energy_mix_kwh_nonneg_check.value:
"ev_charge_energy_mix"."kwh" > 0 AND "ev_charge_energy_mix"."kwh" < 1000 AND "ev_charge_energy_mix"."grid_kwh" >= 0 AND "ev_charge_energy_mix"."solar_kwh" >= 0
        AND "ev_charge_energy_mix"."battery_grid_kwh" >= 0 AND "ev_charge_energy_mix"."battery_solar_kwh" >= 0
        AND "ev_charge_energy_mix"."battery_unpriced_kwh" >= 0 AND "ev_charge_energy_mix"."no_house_data_kwh" >= 0

ev_charge_energy_mix_battery_grid_spot_c.name: ev_charge_energy_mix_battery_grid_spot_check
ev_charge_energy_mix_battery_grid_spot_c.value:
("ev_charge_energy_mix"."battery_grid_kwh" > 0) = ("ev_charge_energy_mix"."battery_grid_spot_sek" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("ev_charge_energy_mix"."battery_grid_spot_sek" IS NULL
          OR ("ev_charge_energy_mix"."battery_grid_spot_sek" > '-Infinity' AND "ev_charge_energy_mix"."battery_grid_spot_sek" < 'Infinity'))

ev_charge_energy_mix_battery_solar_spot_.name: ev_charge_energy_mix_battery_solar_spot_check
ev_charge_energy_mix_battery_solar_spot_.value:
("ev_charge_energy_mix"."battery_solar_kwh" > 0) = ("ev_charge_energy_mix"."battery_solar_spot_sek" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("ev_charge_energy_mix"."battery_solar_spot_sek" IS NULL
          OR ("ev_charge_energy_mix"."battery_solar_spot_sek" > '-Infinity' AND "ev_charge_energy_mix"."battery_solar_spot_sek" < 'Infinity'))

integration_sync_alerted_at_error_code_c.name: integration_sync_alerted_at_error_code_check
integration_sync_alerted_at_error_code_c.value: "integration_sync"."alerted_at" IS NULL OR "integration_sync"."error_code" IS NOT NULL

integration_sync_last_error_message_erro.name: integration_sync_last_error_message_error_code_check
integration_sync_last_error_message_erro.value: "integration_sync"."last_error_message" IS NULL OR "integration_sync"."error_code" IS NOT NULL

integration_sync_credential_reminder_exp.name: integration_sync_credential_reminder_expiry_check
integration_sync_credential_reminder_exp.value: "integration_sync"."credential_reminder_days" IS NULL OR "integration_sync"."credential_expires_at" IS NOT NULL

integration_sync_progress_range_check.name: integration_sync_progress_range_check
integration_sync_progress_range_check.value: "integration_sync"."progress_total" IS NULL OR ("integration_sync"."progress_total" > 0 AND "integration_sync"."progress_done" BETWEEN 0 AND "integration_sync"."progress_total")

sensor_alert_rule_shape_check.name: sensor_alert_rule_shape_check
sensor_alert_rule_shape_check.value:
("sensor_alert_rule"."kind" IN ('temperature', 'humidity') AND "sensor_alert_rule"."direction" IS NOT NULL AND "sensor_alert_rule"."threshold" IS NOT NULL AND "sensor_alert_rule"."count" IS NOT NULL AND "sensor_alert_rule"."silence_hours" IS NULL)
        OR ("sensor_alert_rule"."kind" = 'battery' AND "sensor_alert_rule"."direction" IS NOT NULL AND "sensor_alert_rule"."direction" = 'below' AND "sensor_alert_rule"."threshold" IS NOT NULL AND "sensor_alert_rule"."count" IS NOT NULL AND "sensor_alert_rule"."silence_hours" IS NULL)
        OR ("sensor_alert_rule"."kind" = 'silence' AND "sensor_alert_rule"."silence_hours" IS NOT NULL AND "sensor_alert_rule"."direction" IS NULL AND "sensor_alert_rule"."threshold" IS NULL AND "sensor_alert_rule"."count" IS NULL)

sensor_alert_rule_threshold_check.name: sensor_alert_rule_threshold_check
sensor_alert_rule_threshold_check.value:
"sensor_alert_rule"."threshold" IS NULL
        OR ("sensor_alert_rule"."kind" = 'temperature' AND "sensor_alert_rule"."threshold" BETWEEN -40 AND 60 AND "sensor_alert_rule"."threshold" * 2 = round("sensor_alert_rule"."threshold" * 2))
        OR ("sensor_alert_rule"."kind" = 'humidity' AND "sensor_alert_rule"."threshold" BETWEEN 1 AND 99 AND "sensor_alert_rule"."threshold" = round("sensor_alert_rule"."threshold"))
        OR ("sensor_alert_rule"."kind" = 'battery' AND "sensor_alert_rule"."threshold" BETWEEN 5 AND 95 AND "sensor_alert_rule"."threshold" = round("sensor_alert_rule"."threshold"))

ev_session_cost_priced_check.name: ev_session_cost_priced_check
ev_session_cost_priced_check.value:
("ev_session_cost"."priced_generation" IS NULL) = ("ev_session_cost"."pricing_version" IS NULL)
        AND ("ev_session_cost"."priced_generation" IS NULL) = ("ev_session_cost"."estimated" IS NULL)

ev_session_cost_month_finite_check.name: ev_session_cost_month_finite_check
ev_session_cost_month_finite_check.value: "ev_session_cost_month"."kwh" > '-Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."kwh" < 'Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."grid_kwh" > '-Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."grid_kwh" < 'Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."full_kwh" > '-Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."full_kwh" < 'Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."no_price_kwh" > '-Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."no_price_kwh" < 'Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."no_tariff_kwh" > '-Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."no_tariff_kwh" < 'Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."spot_sek" > '-Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."spot_sek" < 'Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."fees_sek" > '-Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."fees_sek" < 'Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."total_sek" > '-Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."total_sek" < 'Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."solar_kwh" > '-Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."solar_kwh" < 'Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."battery_kwh" > '-Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."battery_kwh" < 'Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."no_house_data_kwh" > '-Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."no_house_data_kwh" < 'Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."solar_value_sek" > '-Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."solar_value_sek" < 'Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."solar_priced_kwh" > '-Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."solar_priced_kwh" < 'Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."solar_unpriced_kwh" > '-Infinity' AND "ev_session_cost_month"."solar_unpriced_kwh" < 'Infinity'
